## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasContainer> CreateContainer( const std::string& id, float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 0, float h = 0);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasContainer> CreateScrollableContainer( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h, bool enableVertical = true, bool enableHorizontal = false);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasContainer(const std::string &id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasContainer(const std::string &id, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasContainer(const std::string &id);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### struct `ContainerStyle`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `clipChildren` | `bool clipChildren = true` | Children are drawn clipped to the content area (the default), or - false, CSS's overflow: visible - wherever they reach, a child that is wider than its box drawing past it (only the clip of the containers around applies). HTML boxes use false. |
| `autoShowScrollbars` | `bool autoShowScrollbars = false` | A container that really is a viewport onto taller content says so: CreateScrollableContainer(), or `autoShowScrollbars = true` (plus the per-axis flags below). That is a handful of places, and each of them is a deliberate scroll view rather than an accident of two pixels. |
| `autoShowVerticalScrollbar` | `bool autoShowVerticalScrollbar = true` | Per-axis refinement, consulted only once autoShowScrollbars is on. Lets a pane whose content reflows to its width (e.g. book text) opt out of the horizontal bar: when the vertical scrollbar appears it narrows the viewport by its track size, which would otherwise fabricate a track-sized horizontal overflow of content … |
| `autoShowHorizontalScrollbar` | `bool autoShowHorizontalScrollbar = true` |  |
| `forceShowVerticalScrollbar` | `bool forceShowVerticalScrollbar = false` |  |
| `forceShowHorizontalScrollbar` | `bool forceShowHorizontalScrollbar = false` |  |
| `scrollbarStyle` | `ScrollbarStyle scrollbarStyle = GetDefaultScrollbarStyleOr(ScrollbarStyle::Default())` |  |
